description.value: Sushi ON is a Japanese restaurant in Burnaby's Edmonds neighbourhood offering dine-in, takeout, and third-party delivery through Skip the Dishes, Uber Eats, and DoorDash. The menu centres on sushi rolls, with house favourites like California Roll and Tempura alongside a broader selection of Japanese dishes. It is one of two Lower Mainland locations, with a sister restaurant in Port Coquitlam.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's front page (https://sushion.ca/burnaby/) has been compromised and serves spam gambling content (SLOT138/Etsy scam), but subpages (/join, /blog/en/, etc.) load legitimate Sushi ON content confirming the business at 7617 Edmonds St, Burnaby with phone (604) 521-1550. The subpages confirm takeout and delivery via Skip the Dishes, Uber Eats, and DoorDash, as well as dine-in service, but contain no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cyclist-relevant amenities. OSM tags add only smoking=no.
concerns: The canonical URL https://sushion.ca/burnaby/ is serving injected spam/gambling content (SLOT138 slot-machine scam via Etsy) — the domain's front page appears compromised. Subpages still load legitimate Sushi ON content, but the website should be flagged for the business owner.
Website footer shows '© 2022 Sushi ON', suggesting the site may not be actively maintained, which may have contributed to the front-page compromise.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate operating restaurant, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to assess eligibility.
